purpose: Teach: 文藝春秋/自営業/発刊/主将/関心事/講堂/ブレーク/学識

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 文藝春秋系の雑誌に当社の広告を出しましょう
lines.en: Let's place our company's advertisement in a Bungei Shunju magazine.
lines.style: Decisive, forward-leaning. Clipped opening. Sets the agenda without asking permission. Businesslike tempo, no softening.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。自営業の方向けの提案書を作成中です
lines.en: Yes. I'm currently working on a proposal for self-employed business owners.
lines.style: Attentive, responsive. Soft acknowledgment on 'Yes' then pivots to update. Shows progress. Calm, competent register throughout.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 新雑誌の発刊記念パーティーを企画しましょう
lines.en: Let's also organize a launch party for the new magazine.
lines.style: Building momentum. Slight upward inflection on the opening. Strategic, adding layers to the plan. Confident pacing.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。お得意様の野球部主将を招待します
lines.en: Yes. We'll invite our regular customers—especially the captain of their company baseball team.
lines.style: Practical detail-oriented. Small pause before specificity to show he's considered this carefully. Even, reliable tone.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: お客様の関心事を反映したサービスを開発しましょう
lines.en: We should develop a service that directly reflects what our clients care about.
lines.style: Thoughtful but assured. Slight weight on the core idea. Strategic vision in the delivery—not tentative, but collaborative.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。講堂で社員総会を開催します
lines.en: Yes. We'll hold the general staff meeting in the main hall.
lines.style: Steady, matter-of-fact. Confirms and executes. No hesitation. Professional rhythm.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 新商品で市場をブレークさせたいですね
lines.en: We really need to break into the market with this new product.
lines.style: Heightened intensity here. The word 'really' carries genuine urgency. Slightly faster tempo. Ambition surfacing beneath the composed surface.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。学識経験者を顧問に招きます
lines.en: Yes. I'll bring on an academic advisor to guide our strategy.
lines.style: Closing statement with finality. Calm assurance. Shows competent follow-through on the larger vision. Steady, grounded conclusion.
